dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-intensity white/cream perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to low-intensity dark cores. Outer edges show non-uniform, serrated geometry particularly in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters located on the anterior-lateral region near the neck and lower lateral flanks, transitioning into an interconnected reticulated pattern without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene quadrilateral. Three distinct high-intensity blobs located posterior to the ocular region form a compact, nearly right-angled triangle.
